data.title: 胡桃 · 和裕茶馆跨界听书
data.description: 【跨界想象·和裕茶馆】临窗雅座里，胡桃一手托腮，另一手端起青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，饶有兴致地听台上讲《三国演义》。红木桌上留着盖碗托碟与精致茶点；这次把现实小说搬进璃月茶楼的演出，让她也想试着给故事续一首打油诗。
data.action: 跨界听书时一手托腮，另一手举青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，托碟与茶点留在桌上
data.lighting: 茶楼雕花木窗滤过的柔和暖木色光影
data.promptProse: Hu Tao sits at the Heyu Tea House window, listening to an unseen storyteller recount Three Kingdoms. Her left palm supports her cheek while her right hand lifts a celadon bowl to cool the steam. Keep the dark sweater and red skirt in the eye-level medium shot. A lid, saucer and pastries remain arranged on the near redwood table; behind her, the window ledge meets a wooden screen that turns into the quieter seating area. Afternoon light passes through the lattice in broken rectangles on the tabletop. It catches the bowl rim and the side of her amused face, leaving a small shadow under the saucer and softer reflected warmth along her supporting wrist.
